## Problem & Context

Notes decay unless something maintains them. Karpathy proposes that "The LLM
writes and maintains the wiki; the human reads and asks questions".

## Key idea

Three layers: raw sources, the wiki, and the schema. The wiki is "a persistent,
compounding artifact".

## Results

A flat index holds up to about 100 sources, published 2026-04-02.

## Relevance to us

Baseline for the brain, see [LLM wiki](/wiki/page/llm-wiki.md).
